Definition: Does the government maintain a digital business register?
Comments: Doing Business 2020 describes company registration through the Guiché Único (one-stop shop) which issues a company registration certificate and requests a taxpayer identification number, indicating digitization/streamlining but not clearly fully online nationwide; thus classified as partially deployed.
redteam_note: Scored >0 but NO source cited — unsupported claim, verify first.
revised_source_urls: World Bank Doing Business 2020 STP PDF (https://archive.doingbusiness.org/content/dam/doingBusiness/country/s/sao-tome-and-principe/STP.pdf); World Bank São Tomé e Príncipe Digital project document, 2025 (https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099102025185177863/pdf/P177158-d0ebd79d-6646-4e92-b9ae-1183b632c15a.pdf); DGRN Guiché Único procedures page (https://dgrn.gov.st/reg_gue.php)
revision_notes: DB2020 only confirms a paper-based one-stop shop (Guiché Único) for company registration; it does not describe a digital register. A 2025 World Bank STP Digital project diagnostic is far more current and explicit: it describes the GUE business register as having 'outdated and fragmented digital systems with total dependence on paper' and sets out plans to transform it into a modern, data-oriented register. Revised down from 4 (partially deployed) to 3 (under development), since digitisation is being planned/scoped but not yet delivered.
